title: Panchayat Kavach Insurance - Eligibility
text: All the accounts opened effective 15th Mar'25 will be eligible for complimentary insurance cover for 5 lacs Sum Insured.

title: Panchayat Kavach Insurance - Policy Validity Period
text: The policy will be valid only for 1 year from the account opening date.

title: Panchayat Kavach Insurance - Policy Cancellation
text: To cancel the insurance policy, the account holder can provide a declaration for discontinuance of the policy signed as per mode of operation in the account at the nearest branch.

title: Panchayat Kavach Insurance - Non-Availing of Benefits
text: If the account holder chooses not to avail the complimentary insurance benefit during the account opening process, the entity can provide the declaration stating that no insurance policy will be issued.

title: Panchayat Kavach Insurance - Live Account Requirement for Claims
text: Claims will be processed only for live accounts. For any claims, please submit the claim form at the nearest branch.

title: Panchayat Kavach Insurance - Covered Perils for Claims
text: In the event of any of the loss to the property (Gram Panchayat Offices) due to any Fire, Explosion/Implosion, Lighting, Earthquake, Volcanic eruption, or other convulsion of nature, Strom, Cyclone, Typhoon, Tempest, Hurricane, Tornado, Tsunami, Flood and Inundation, Subsidence, Rockslide, Landslide, Bush Fire, Forest Fire, Jungle Fire, Impact Damage of any kind (excluding caused by insured own vehicle), Missile testing operation, Riot, Strike, Malicious Damage, Bursting or overflowing of water tanks, apparatus and pipes, Leakage from automatic sprinkler, Theft within 7 days from the occurrence of and proximately cause by any of the above insured event, entity to approach the nearest branch and submit the claim form at branch.

title: Panchayat Kavach - Fire
text: Loss to the covered property due to Fire is covered under the policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach - Explosion/Implosion
text: Loss to the covered property due to Explosion/Implosion is covered under the policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach - Earthquake and Natural Convulsion
text: Loss to the covered property due to Earthquake, Volcanic eruption, or other convulsion of nature is covered under the policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach - Storm and Weather Events
text: Loss to the covered property due to Strom, Cyclone, Typhoon, Tempest, Hurricane, Tornado, Tsunami, Flood, and Inundation is covered under the policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach - Subsidence and Landslide
text: Loss to the covered property due to Subsidence, Rockslide, Landslide is covered under the policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach - Forest Fires
text: Loss to the covered property due to Bush Fire, Forest Fire, Jungle Fire is covered under the policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach - Impact Damage
text: Loss to the covered property due to Impact Damage of any kind excluding caused by insured own vehicle is covered under the policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach - Missile Testing
text: Loss to the covered property due to Missile testing operation is covered under the policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach - Riot and Malicious Damage
text: Loss to the covered property due to Riot, Strike, Malicious Damage is covered under the policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach - Water Damage
text: Loss to the covered property due to Bursting or overflowing of water tanks, apparatus, and pipes is covered under the policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach - Sprinkler Leakage
text: Loss to the covered property due to Leakage from automatic sprinkler is covered under the policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach - Theft
text: Loss to the covered property due to Theft within 7 days from the occurrence of and proximately cause by any of the above insured event is covered under the policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Excess
text: Excess of Rs. 5,000 (Rupees Five Thousand) for each claim. This means that the insurer will deduct Rs. 5000 for each and every loss suffered under the terms of this policy. For terrorism risk the Excess shall be as per the Clause attached to this policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Deliberate/Willful Acts
text: Your deliberate, willful or intentional act or omission, or of anyone on Your behalf, or with Your connivance.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Electrical/Electronic Damage
text: Loss, damage or destruction to any electrical/electronic machine, apparatus, fixture, or fitting by over-running, excessive pressure, short circuiting, arcing, self-heating or leakage of electricity from whatever cause (lightning included). This exclusion applies only to the particular machine so lost, damaged or destroyed. However, any ensuing loss or damage to other insured property due to operation of an insured peril is covered.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Cold Storage Temperature Loss
text: Loss, destruction or damage to the stocks in cold storage premises caused by change of temperature.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Process/Operation Interruption
text: Loss, or damage by spoilage resulting from the retardation or interruption or cessation of any process or operation caused by operation of any of the Insured Events.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Unoccupied Premises
text: Your Premises or any Insured Building remaining continuously unoccupied for a period of more than 30 days, unless You have obtained prior written approval from the insurer and such approval is recorded as an endorsement on the Policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - War and Civil Commotion
text: War, invasion, act of foreign enemy hostilities or war-like operations (whether war is declared or not), civil war, mutiny, civil commotion amounting to a popular rising, military rising, rebellion, revolution, insurrection or military or usurped power.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Ionising Radiation and Nuclear
text: Ionising radiation or contamination by radioactivity from any nuclear fuel or from any nuclear waste from combustion of nuclear fuel, or the radioactive, toxic, explosive or other hazardous properties of any explosive nuclear assembly or nuclear component that is part of it.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Pollution/Contamination
text: Pollution or contamination, unless (i) the pollution or contamination itself has resulted from an Insured Event, in which case only physical damage to the Insured Property is covered, or (ii) an Insured Event itself results from pollution or contamination.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Precious Items
text: Loss, destruction or damage to bullion or unset precious stones, any curios or works of art unless such amount is declared separately and recorded in the Policy Schedule.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Missing Property
text: Loss of any Insured Property which is missing or has been mislaid, or its disappearance cannot be linked to any single identifiable Insured Event.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Removed Property
text: Loss or damage to any Insured Property removed from Your Premises to any other place, except (i) Machinery and equipment temporarily removed for repairs, cleaning, renovation or other similar purposes for a period not exceeding 60 days (ii) Stock covered under 'Temporary removal of stocks'.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Market Value Reduction
text: Any reduction in market value of any Insured Property after its repair or reinstatement.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Marine Policy Coverage
text: Loss or damage to any Insured Property or any claim which is covered by a marine policy in force at the time of loss or damage, except in excess of the limits of that policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Consequential/Indirect Loss
text: Any consequential or indirect loss or damage of any description, i.e. losses or extra costs (financial or non-financial) that follow or are a consequence of an Insured Event, like, loss by delay, loss of income or wages or earnings, or of market, or of time, medical expenses, or any costs not covered by this Policy.

title: Panchayat Kavach Exclusion - Claim Preparation Costs
text: Costs, fees or expenses for preparing any claims.

title: Panchayat Kavach Insurance - Geographic Coverage Exclusions
text: Except Dehradoon, Haridwar and Udhamsingh Nagar, in Uttarakhand all other location is blocked/decline, in addition to Meghalaya and Tripura.

title: Panchayat Kavach Insurance - Account Closure Disclaimer
text: On the account being closed for whatever reason, the benefit of such insurance cover shall automatically cease to be available from such date of closure of account.

title: Panchayat Kavach Insurance - Insurer's Rights and Bank's Limitation
text: The insurer reserves the right to process or reject the Insurance Cover claim or require further / additional information in respect of the same from customer and shall not hold HDFC Bank responsible or liable in any manner whatsoever.

title: Panchayat Kavach Insurance - Information Sharing and Data Handling
text: HDFC Bank to pass on the interest of availing the Insurance Cover including the details furnished by customer at the time of account opening to the insurers. Customer will intimate HDFC Bank in case of any claims to be availed under the Insurance Cover and agree to submit such details as may be required by HDFC Bank and the insurer(s). HDFC Bank will pass on Bank account details held with HDFC Bank to the insurer(s) for settlement of any claim amount.
